summary: Known High and Critical vulnerabilities in the base software no longer ship.

fixes.title: Built on today's patched base software
fixes.text: Every job and page is now built with the operating system's latest security updates, so fixed High and Critical vulnerabilities no longer ship.
fixes.action: If your private network firewall allows only listed hosts, add archive.ubuntu.com and security.ubuntu.com to it before the update installs.

fixes.title: Online documentation matches the product
fixes.text: The pages on invardia.com now match the product: the Conditional Access changes a SuperAdmin can make, every identity and its rights, all jobs, settings and install options.
